inputs.original_text: As a parent of three children in the city’s public schools, I want to publicly apologize to the educators and staff of South Portland School District. inputs.modified_text: A South Portland parent of three is apologizing to school staff as the district faces a budget shortfall and cuts of more than 70 positions. It’s a painful situation, especially for the families and employees affected—but calling every shortfall proof that schools simply need more money is too easy. School leaders owe parents and taxpayers a clear account of how resources are being managed before asking the community to accept more cuts or bigger costs. Children and dedicated staff shouldn’t be left to bear the consequences of poor decisions.
